subject.title: feat(chat): rewind and fork a session from a message bubble

question: Should OpenClaw expose per-message rewind and fork as durable core gateway/session operations, with the proposed `operator.admin` versus `operator.write` permission split?
rationale: This is a new user-facing core capability that changes persisted session lifecycle behavior and expands the public gateway contract; automated review cannot choose its permanent UX, authorization, or upgrade policy.

options.title: Sponsor the core feature
options.body: Confirm the core session and authorization direction, require redacted real-session proof, and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep a safer UI-only or fork-only subset if maintainers do not want rewind to repoint the active persisted session.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR until a durable product and gateway API decision is recorded.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core feature
recommendation.body: Confirm the core session and authorization direction, require redacted real-session proof, and continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied change history identifies this contributor as the active implementer most able to clarify the proposed session and UI behavior; final sponsorship remains a repository-owner decision.
